description: Illustrates the anonymous -> authenticated -> reset -> authenticated (different account) lifecycle described in specification/identity.md. Each entry is one conceptual operation call, in order, followed by the resulting identity state.

sequence.note: identify() is called immediately after signup_completed, per specification/identity.md. anonymous_id is retained alongside user_id.
Logout. user_id and user-level properties are cleared; a new anonymous_id is issued rather than reusing ANON_100, per the privacy rationale in specification/identity.md.
A second, different account signs in on the same device. reset() was called before identify(), per the account-switching guidance in specification/identity.md.
